description: Violates G4 / §4.4 by omission (verification-contract.md §4.3–§4.4): the declaration omits gates.standardAddsChecksNeverWeakensGates. The gate set is a floor, not a ceiling — a declaration that does not affirm the floor is non-conforming, because silence would let a standard weaken a gate without saying so. The required gate declaration rejects the omission.
